# Inactive Hellfurnace movement

The unchanged original Hellfurnace attachment affects both teams. An original
cardless MageT1_Junker crosses its boundary while moon tracking is disabled.
Six native Bumps cover Full entry/exit, stale Full-to-New understanding on
entry and exit (mask 6 to 5), and aligned New return. The original room marker
upgrade appears and disappears with membership. The attachment also carries a
Pyregel stack bonus, but this enemy has no Pyregel status; that bonus is not
exercised here.

Two muted Instant native processes produced equal complete archive roots.
The model matches every train/context and gameplay RNG successor, with eight
immutable branches per row. A renamed enemy is accepted by the structural
rule; missing masks, preview, unknown spawner, changed attachment identity and
moon callbacks remain rejected. The 9,764-byte binary has 1,142 unique nodes
and SHA-256 `1cdb8a15626684b886b285c0030515787bc1c22572f04ab1927098ac873675e5`.
Original game files were unchanged. Natural EndTurn ascension remains separate.

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Run-FullBattleProbe.ps1 -RoomMoonInactiveHellfurnaceMovement -GameSpeed Instant
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Check-Models.ps1 -Fixture room-moon-inactive-hellfurnace-movement-calibration.mt2f
```
